title: Whimsical Knight Canonical Representation
description: A rows x cols lattice of dots with no grid lines. Some cells between the dots hold a gray square. White circles sit on a dot or on the midpoint between two orthogonally neighbouring dots; white squares sit on a dot. Positions use doubled coordinates: dot (r, c) is (2r, 2c). The solver draws one closed loop of orthogonal and knight's-move segments between dots that passes straight through every circle, turns at a right angle at every square, never crosses or branches, and never runs a knight segment over a gray square.

gray.description: (rows - 1) x (cols - 1) cells between the dots; 1 = gray square, 0 = empty.

circles.description: White circles: on a dot (dr, dc both even) or an orthogonal midpoint (exactly one odd).

squares.description: White squares: always on a dot (dr, dc both even).
